The Jew's Coming Punishment; Their Universal and Incurable Impenitence.</title> <div sID="gen17276" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9774"/>1. The victorious Babylonians were about to violate the sanctuaries of the dead in search of plunder; for ornaments, treasures, and insignia of royalty were usually buried with kings. entries.content_plain: 19.
